game.name: Kameo : Elements of Power (USA)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Zh,Ko)
game.desc: Kameo: Elements of Power for Xbox 360 is an action-adventure game in which you play as a being capable of transforming into almost anything. Assume the power of your inner warriors to fly to the rescue of your Elemental Ancestors and eliminate Thorn, the evil king of the Trolls.
